title: Theme contrast, in-app file browser, visual refresh and measured engine wins
request:
Three parts. (1) Fix the contrast issue seen with herdr's built-in themes: with other themes the contrast is off (screenshots show low-contrast secondary text like timestamps, 'Comment', 'Open terminal', agent names, inline code chips and user bubbles: C:\Users\athenkosi.hlubi\.config\herdr-app\data\bot-herdr\pasted\pasted-20261111-094735.png and pasted-20261111-094742.png). (2) Attaching a document fails to open a file explorer. (3) Review the current features: what could be improved, what can be removed, what visual layout would be best, performance improvements, token efficiency, cache hit rates, etc.

The agreed plan: bh plan show p-20261111-9dkc

steps.title: Make every text colour reach WCAG AA (4.5:1 text, 3:1 controls) under every herdr theme and our own pair, keeping each theme's character: quiet text, accent text, status colours, agent name colours and the send button (Design).

Fill missing surfaces for theme files with no `colors` block (atom-one-dark) from the theme itself, use the theme's `solid`/`solid_foreground` for the send button, and soften the bubble border to match bot-herdr's own theme (Design).
Draw inline code chips in replies ourselves, in the theme's colours, at AA (Design).
Add a committed snapshot of every herdr theme and one contrast test over it plus our light/dark pair (QA).
Add a `bh` command that lists a folder's entries for a space, including spaces on other machines (Dev).
Replace the system dialog behind "Attach document…" with a file browser in the attach pane: folders, files, search, multi-select, and a visible message when listing fails (Design).
Trim the agent briefs, the QA risk prompt and the script question, and merge the duplicated engine helpers (Dev).
Tidy the layout details: "Open terminal" and "Comment" on hover and focus, the page switch on `palette()`, no "to" prefix (Design).
Refresh the visual design of every page on one compact type scale, spacing set, radii, elevation and motion system, with focus and press states everywhere (Design).
Lighten the Knowledge cards and agent filter chips in light mode: white cards on the paper ground with the agent's colour as a dot and a thin accent, not a grey tinted fill (Design).

Replace the plain markdown editor (knowledge notes and `.md` files opened in the viewer) with a live-preview editor: every block shows rendered, and the block you click or move into turns into its source for editing (Design).
Add text search to the code viewer and editor: Ctrl+F opens a search field over the file, shows "3 of 12" with next and previous, and lists the matching lines with the match highlighted (Design).
Make the toast close as smoothly as it opens: the bubble shrinks back into the composer's top edge and fades out in one continuous motion, and is removed only once it is invisible (Design).
Confirm, with sources, how each harness reports the models it offers: Claude Code, Codex, pi, Oh My Pi, OpenCode, Gemini, Qwen Code and Antigravity (Research).
Add `bh models <harness>` that asks the installed harness on the space's machine for its real models and caches the answer (Dev).
Make each agent card's model picker show the harness's real models, with a refresh button and a clear note when the harness could not be asked (Design).

Take the plan document out of the Plans page's conversation: a "View plan" tab rises from the composer's top edge (document icon, label, chevron, as in the person's screenshot) and opens the plan in a pop-up window that can be expanded to fill the app, with line comments and Start task working there (Design).
Rerun the contrast test, `bh check`, QA gate, commit, push, `node install.mjs`, `herdr-app check`.

focusAreas: security boundaries: the wrong user, no user and an expired session are refused, and no secret leaks
destructive operations: they touch only what they should, and a failure halfway leaves things recoverable
concurrency: races, ordering, double runs, and a lock or claim that is never released
state transitions and recovery: no illegal or stuck state, and a crash or failed step recovers
isolation: work stays inside its branch, worktree and permission boundaries
riskFactors: a wide change: 31 files, 4446 changed lines across 7 modules ((top), mods/bot-herdr, mods/bot-herdr/engine and 4 more)
tests changed with it: test/knowledge-classifier.test.mjs, test/palette.test.mjs, test/themes.test.mjs and 15 more
qa.reasoning: HIGH: security: mods/bot-herdr/settings.js ("permission"); destructive operations: mods/bot-herdr/chat.js ("truncate"); concurrency: mods/bot-herdr/mdblocks.js (by its path). the engine's rules (Jev is off or had nothing to read).

comments.text: When done with all the steps, commit and push to git. Then rebuild plugin and install it.
